tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rje btsun dam pa rdzogs chen pa bsod nams dbang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus bzhugs so// 386)na mo mū la gu ru bhyaḥ bla ma brgya yod stong yod kyang*// rang sems ngo sprod bla ma'i rab// gang gi zhabs pad la btud de// mdzad pa'i cha shas mdo tsam bri/ skyes chen dam pa nges don mthar phyin dpal bzang po'i gsung gis/ bdag la rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa'i rje btsun dam pa bsod nams dbang po de nyid kyi lo rgyus 'dri bar mdzad pa'i lan du phul ba ni/ rje de nyid sku 'khrungs sa'i yul ni kong stod rkyen gyi tsha zhugs ces pa'i grong du/ 'bri gung kyu ra'i gdung gi char btogs pa cazhag tu lcags khyi'i lor 'khrungs te/ sku gzhon dus khyim thabs mdzad pa'i sras mo 387)gcig byung ba de sku mdun bya khyung gi sras rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya mor gyur/ sras gzhan med pa na dgung lo sum cu so dgu par khyim spangs nas jo mo dang gnyis kas chos sha stag byed pa'i tshig chad byas te bya khyung pa ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal gyi drung du skra bcad cing skyabs sdom nas bzung ste gsang sngags kyi chos ji snyed zhus/ de skabs su grwa rigs gzhan rnams kyis rje 'di la rgan zhugs kyi mthong dang khyad gsod byed kyang*/ bla ma de nyid kyis 'gro don can du 'byung bar mkhyen te zab chos thams cad rtsal sprugs su gnang zhing slob ma gzhan las lhag pa'i brtse ba 388)dang chos kyi pha phogs bum pa gang byor gnang nas sgrub pa la bcug par mdzad pa'i mthus/ rje 'dis kyang rtswa ri stag tshang dang dom tshang*/ pu ri rgyab/ zil chen sogs dang sgam po sgrod chen sgrod chung*/ rkyen gyi 'gring phu/ dgon gsar lhun grub steng sogs ri khrod nges med du dka' thub bcud len la brten zhing bzhugs/ de dag gi skabs tshor yang bla ma ngag dbang padma de nyid mnal lam sprul bsgyur sogs la dbang thob pa yod 'dug pas/

rje 'di la yi dam rtsa gsum gyi skur bstan pa dang*/ gnyan sa gcod pa'i sar stag gi gzugs ri bo tsam du bstan nas thugs dam gyi drod myul ba sogs kyang mdzad par gda' la phyis sku drung du sleb skabs de dag gi gsung gleng mdzad pas dpon slob gnyis ka phan tshun du mnyes te/ sngon rje sgam po pa dang dbu se gnyis kyi mdzad pa dang cha 'drar byung zhing*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed rang dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su dkyil 'khor dang cho ga dang dbang gi phyag len dang gar dbyangs sogs 389)la'ang rtog 'jug bslab sbyang ci nus bgyis gsungs pa la/ rje 'di pas sku mkhyen no/ bdag gtir rgan 'di 'dra ba tshe mjug 'di ri khrod lung stong 'grim pa ma gtogs gzhan gyi mgo 'dren sogs byed pa'i re thag chod zhus pas/ min min/ nam zhig tsa na mi byed ka med kyi dus shig 'ong bar 'dug des na gzhan rtsol bar mi byed kyang zab khrid khyod rang gi gang thob thams cad kyi phyag bzhes nges dag brdar sha tshod pa cig gyis shig gsungs nas de ltar mdzad/ gzhan yang chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma ni/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang dkon mchog yan lag dpal gtsug lag 'phreng ba/ 'brug pa padma dkar po sogs dang*/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo mang zhig la thug slad du rje btsun ngag dbang padma de nyid dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim rjes na/ rje 'di nyid sngon gyi smon lam gyis bskul mthus kong gnas rnams mjal ba 390) la kho rang gcig pu bya bral tshul gyis phebs pa las/ rim pas gtsang po mgo dgur mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i drung du phyag dbang zhu bar byon nas chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas thugs yid ches te/ phyag phyi ba dag la bka' stsal nas/ khyed tshos bya bral 'di la brnyas pa'i rigs ma byed cig 'di ni gzugs mi mdzes kyang nang nas nyams rtogs me 'bar 'bar yod pa/ skyal gog me 'bar zhig tu 'dug go

zhes gsungs skad/ rje 'dis kyang mtshungs med de nyid la khyod nyid bai ro tsa na yin par 'dug pas na/ bdag gis sngar rdzogs chen gyi khrid rigs mang du thob kyang*/ bai ro'i rdor sems snying tig 'di ma thob pa dang*/ 'dir bzhugs na bai ro dngos la thob pa dang 'dra bar snang bas cis kyang zhu'o zhes zhus tshe bka' las/ 'o na de ltar byas chog gi khyed rang yang nged kyi grub sde 'dir bzhugs mdzod gsungs nas dpon slob gnyis ka dgongs pa mthun par 391)byung bas/ rdor sems snying tig dang gzhan yang tshem bu smar khrid sogs mang du gsan zhing*/ gtsang po mgo dgur sku mtshams la rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ slad du mtshungs med de nyid gshegs shul du dgon gong 'og gnyis ka'i grwa rigs kyis rje 'di par bka' chos zhu mkhan rim gyis mang du byung zhing*/ lan zhig gi tshe/ 'di phyogs na sa lugs kyi chos sde spro steng zhes pa'i grwa pa bsam 'grub zer ba zhig gis rje 'di la gsung chos phran bu thob nas/ slar dbus gtsang gi gnas skor dang gtsang phyogs kyi sa skya'i gdan sa rnams mjal bar phyin pa'i lam zhor la bsam 'grub rtse ru mnyam med sog zlog pa chen po de nyid bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal ba'i gsung gleng 'phros par/ mi de la chos rgyud/ grwa sa/ bla ma gang yin sogs kyi skad cha'i 'phros su/ kho pas rje 'di nyid yon tan 'ga' zhig zhus yod par snang bas/ rje sog zlog pa'i zhal nas/ nged 392)rnying ma ba'i rigs 'di la rnga gog gding gding 'ba' zhig byed mkhan ma gtogs/ rdzogs pa chen po bsgom zhing 'chad nus pa gar yang shin tu dkon pa yod/ khyod kyi bla ma de'i skad cha thos pas yid spro yang khyed tsho thag ring gi skad cha gcig bu la bden par zung tshod mi zin pas nged rang brtag pa zhig byed pa yin/ khyed rang sang nyin bdag gi rtsar shog cig gsungs/ nang par sku drung du phyin pas gsol ras mang du gnang zhing*/

'o/ khyod kyi skad cha la g.yo zol mi 'dug bdag gis mdang rmi lam bzung nas lta bar phyin pas/ spyir kong lung pa/ sgos su gtsang po 'go dgu'i dgon pa/ khyad par du grub thob de'i gzims spyil dang sku'i dbyibs thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du mthong byung zhing*/ rje de'i sku dang zhal gyi rnam 'gyur ni thang stong rgyal po'i sku ji lta ba la snam bu dkar po'i mgo shub cig bzhes nas/ dom lpags bzhugs gdan 393)gyi khar ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang mjal byung*/ bod yul 'dir mi lo brgya brgya na bi ma la'i sprul pa re byon nas rdzogs chen gsung bar bshad 'dug pa de lta bu zhig kyang yin shas che la/ sku dngos ni/ rgyal ba 'brom gyi rnam sprul yin nam snyam pa byung*/ des na bdag ni sa thag ring bas lus kyis mjal ba'i skal ba ma mchis rung yid kyis mjal bas chog cing mchod rdzas 'brel pa zhig khyod la bskur ba yin pas 'bul thub par gyis shig gsungs nas/ gser g.yu dar dang bcas pa'i mtshan grangs dang*/ khyad par brtan bzhugs kyi thugs rtsom du/ ༈ rgya chen bsod nams smin pa'i chos kyi grwar// sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin zhi zhing dbang po dul// yon tan gzhal du med pa'i chos kyi rje// 'gyur med rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ sogs dang*/ gangs can skye dgu'i bsod nams spyi dpal du// rig 'dzin sngags 'chang grub pa'i dbang po khyod/ 394)/nam yang g.yo ba med par zhabs brtan zhing*// gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dpal du brtan par bzhugs// yang zab rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu la// rjod byed tshig dang sgra tsam dbang ba mang*// don gyi ye shes ston mkhas khyed min su// snying po'i bstan srog 'dzin cing brtan par bzhugs/ ces sogs kyi phyag bris dang bcas te bskur bar mdzad pa 'dir phyag tu skyon med 'byor zhing*/ de la brten nas 'di skor du yang mnyam 'grogs kyi dri ma sangs shing dag snang gi mig bye ba'i rkyen du yang gyur la/

dus phyis kyang rje sog zlog pa chen po nyid kyis dgongs 'dus sman sgrub gnang ba'i sman phud bka' tham dang sbrags nas kong po'i kar srid gtsang la 'gro mkhan la bskur ba 'dir phyag tu 'byor ba bdag gis kyang mthong zhing dam rdzas kyang myong*/ rje btsun 'di nyid dgu lo re drug bzhes pa'i shing mo yos lor grwa tshang nas zhabs drung mthu stobs pa'i sprul sku rig 'dzin mchog grub pas spyan drangs te dge 'dun 395)spyi sgos mtha' bdag la zab chos kyi char babs/ de skabs su bdag rang lo brgyad pa yin pas de nas bzung ste lo phyed dang bzhi pa sa rta'i g.yar gzhug gi bar du sku lus dang grib ma ltar bsten rgyu byung zhing*/ sems 'tshol sogs dri 'bul gyi skabs rnams su bdag bu chung bsam med kyi gtam la tha snyad gal 'ong ste/ rje sde pa'i zhal 'phros rnams su/ chos rje slob dpon pa'i thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bag chags gtan nas ma brjed par 'di la bsdad 'dug gsungs shing ngo mtshar che che mo'i tshul mdzad/ slar gtsang po mgo dgur phebs nas kyang yang yang mjal zhing*/ phyis dgung lo don drug pa shing glang gi lor nye mtshams nas bdag la bka' phrin gnang nas khyod la chos bka' gzhan thams cad rtsis phrod kyang*/ rdzogs chen snying po gser gyi yang zhun gyi zab khrid chen mo de gcig pu lus yod pas 396)lan cig cis kyang shog gsungs na'ang bdag grwa tshang gi gnyer khur gyis bcings par re shig 'gyangs/ slar lo de'i dbyug zla shar 'phral che bzhag chung bskyur te phyin pas shin tu mnyes par mdzad cing*/ chos bka' de dag dang gzhan yang dogs gcod sogs zhib nan zhus/ 'gro khar rje nyid rlung sems la dbang thob cing skye 'chi'i 'du byed las grol tshe bdag sogs la dgongs nas yun du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs dgos tshul zhus tshe zhal nas/ da ni bdag la sems kyi lhag ma spu tsam yang ma lus pa dang*/

'byung 'dus 'di'ang rgud ches pas dbang po thams cad kyang mi gsal bar gda' bas 'di tsam la 'gro ba legs pa yin/ spyir yang nga rang sprang po gtir rgan yin kyang*/ khyed dang spu bo rba khang sprul sku sogs skyes chen mang po la chos kyi mchod pa phul thub pa 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rlabs chen 'grub pas blo kha rdzogs yod gsungs/ 397)bdag grwa tshang du log nas zla ba phyi ma smin drug gi nyer lnga'i tho rangs bsnyun gzhi sogs gang yang med par dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ gdung bzhus pas dbu thod tshal bu sor gsum tsam zhig la dbu klad kham bu tsam 'byar ba zhig rgyang ring du 'phar ba thams cad kyi mthong yang re shig la ma rnyed/ slar grwa rgan zhig gis brnyed nas bltas pas/ dbu thod kyi phyi logs la a dkar po 'bur dod mthe bong gi rgya tsam shin tu gsal ba dang*/ dbu klad 'byar ba de thams cad ring srel gyi gong bur song ba zhig byung 'dug pa/ khos de gnyis so sor 'phral te bu thod kho rang gi tshags byas/ dbu klad gzhan zhig la byin 'dug pa bdag gis phyis rting thos nas dri rtsad byas pas dang po med zer slar ster sbyin sogs byas nas blangs pas/ 'o na kho rang dad rten tshab cig dgos zer ba/ padma sam bha wa'i sku zhig byin pas/ da dung khyed rang gi 398)phyag bris thang sku zhig dgos zer bas/ bcu gcig zhal gyi thang sku bris nas sbyin te dbu thod bdag gis blangs pas rim pas a yig de nyid ches cher 'phel nas dbu thod tshal bu de gang bar gyur pa da lta lag thog na bzhugs yod pa dang*/ dbu klad de yang bdag gi mi de la ster sby-in gyis mgu bar byas bas blangs yod kyang*/ 'di lta bu'i rigs la rjes sor gzhan mas ring srel gri gus gzhogs pa sogs byed dogs 'dug par bsam nas grwa tshang du lha chen gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol yod/ de ltar rje de nyid spyir ni thugs zhi zhing dul la dman sa 'ba' shig 'dzin par mdzad pa ma gtogs rtogs ldan gyi tho co'am/

bla gzugs kyi che 'gying sogs gtan mi mdzad/ khyad par bdag 'dra la yang phyag dang mthong bkur sogs tshur mdzad pa ma gtogs phar gtan nas mi bzhes/ grwa tshang du bka' chos dbang khrid 399)gnang dus kyang bzhugs khri dang na bza' gsol dkar skyag sogs ji ltar phul yang*/ nga rang gi tshod nga rang che ba yin pas nga la bla gzugs kyi babs thob lar mi 'ong zhing*/ de 'dra'i rnam dpyod sogs byed kyang mi shes/ dgos pa yang med gsungs nas gra rkyang gi tshul kho na mdzad/ dus rtag tu na bza' cha lugs gsol zas sogs gang byung des chog gi ngang du spros med ma bcos lhug par bzhugs pa las dgag sgrub legs nyes 'dor len 'bad rtsol mi mdzad la/ ja chang sogs kyang gsol zhal gang do las mang ba nam yang mi bzhes shing*/ nan gyis zhus na/ chos pa zer ba de chog shes yod pa zhig dgos pa yin/ byung tshad za 'thung byed pa la yon tan med gsungs/ 'ga' zhig gis dka' thub bcud len sogs kyi zhal gdams zhus tshe/ khyed tsho gzhon dus chos brgyad kyi snang shas byas te/ dka' thub bam/ bcud len nam/ ras rkyang ngam 400)dam bca' khas len sogs rang tshod rang gis ma thigs pa mang po byas nas/ rgas kha 'chi khar song tsa na rang sems rang gis ma 'chun par blo sig btang nas/ kha la ci za dang 'di za med/ lus la ci gyon dang 'di gyon med/ spyod pa ci byed dang 'di byed med pa cazhag 'ong*/ de las da lta nas ma ltogs tsam/ ma 'khyags tsam la brten zhing chog shes pa gcig gal che ba yin/ bcud len yang rtsam pa bcud len las lhag pa gang yang byed mi dgos/ bya byed thams cad mgo mjug 'khyongs pa zhig gyis dang*/ dam bca' mkhas len mang po byed mi dgos/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gsungs pa de las lhag pa'i dam bca' zhig 'o skol chos byed dgos pa mi 'dug gi de tsho tshul bzhin thub pa gyis dang de kas chog chog par gda'o gsungs/ sku gshegs la nye ba'i snga gong tsam nas/

sku 'khor ba dag la/ bdag 'jig rten gyi bya ba ma byas tshe shi 401) na'ang kha chems 'jog rgyu gzhan med/ nga rang gi dad rten o rgyan rin po che'i gser sku chung ngu 'di dang mkha' 'gro yang tig gi pu sti 'di gnyis bya khyung gi gdan sar phul/ phyag rdor gyi thang sku 'di dang phyag gcod gnyis kyi pu sti 'di grwa tshang du dpon slob sprul sku phul/ nga rang gi paṇa zhu 'di spu bo rba kha sprul sku la phul/ dar kha do gsum zhig yod pa sgrub sde 'di kha'i nang sor phul/ gzhan za lhag 'thung lhag phran bu gang yod rnams khyed sgrub sde ba rnams dang tshogs 'khor zhig gyis shig bdag zang zing rtsol sgrub dang gsog 'jog ma byas pas shi ba'i shul du chags rgyu dang lus rgyu med/ chos rgan zhugs yin kyang chung ngu nas sdig pa byed ma myong*/ chos byas nas kyang dkor ha cang za ma myong*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang ba byed ma myong ba 'di nga rang gi blo gdeng drag shos yin no/ gsungs so/ spyir rje 'di bka' chos sogs gnang ba'i tshe 402)yang*/ ljags lung bzhin mdzad na ljags klog mi bzang bas cung zad 'gro chung ba lta bu yod pa dang*/ bka' las kyang*/ bdag gtir rgan du song bas klog zhan pa 'dis lung dag po ma byung na mi rung gsungs nas nges nges dag dag tu mdzad la khrid kyi rigs gang dang ci lta bu gsungs kyang phyag dpe la gzigs mi dgos par thugs thog nas dpe don lung 'dren gsung rgyun sogs sgo du ma nas nyi ma shar shar du gnang bar mdzad/ 'phral 'jig rten gyi bya ba la ni thugs ye nas mi 'jug pa zhig yin par gda' ba dang*/ bzhugs gral lta bu'i tshe yang gzhan rnams 'phral gyi skad cha dri bshad sogs ci lta bu byed kyang gtan nas gsan pa mi gnang tshe/ gtam gyi 'phro lta bu la/ de ltar a yin lags zhus na/ khyed tsho mang po bshad 'dug pa ngas ni rna ba ma nyan pas ci bshad pa rgyus med gsungs/

gzhan gyi chas dang yo byad sogs la'ang spyan gyis gzigs nan che ba tsam yang 403)nam du'ang mdzad pa'i dpe med/ gang la bzhugs kyang thugs dam mnyam bzhag lta stangs ma gtogs dbu sgril sgril tsam mi mdzad/ bza' btung sogs kyang zhim mi zhim ci 'dra drangs kyang thog mar gang drangs pa de ka cung zad bzhes nas/ slar zhim po ci 'dras drangs rung nga rang de kas chog pa yod gsungs nas thag gcod pa las zhim mngar gyi sred pa mi mdzad pa sogs/ mdor na grub thob rnams kyi rnam thar ji lta ba nyid dang*/ de la'ang tshul 'chos dang bcos ma'i lhad dang dri mas cung zad kyang ma bslad par gser zhun thig po lta bu las nam du'ang 'gyur ba mi mnga'a'o/ zhal slob kyang dbus gtsang phyogs nas ni phyong rgyas chos mdzad sogs re re gnyis gnyis tsam las ma byung la/ dpon slob lha btsun sogs dwags kong nas 'gro don nus pa kha thor tsam dang*/ gtso bor nged rang gi dgon lag dang grwa slob sogs yod phyogs kyi stabs las/ spu bo dang kaḥthog mdo khams/ 'jang zhabs sogs nas mang bar byung song la/ de thams cad la bka' chos ni rdzogs chen snying tig ya bzhi/ mdzod bdun skor/ rdor sems snying thig bar do thos grol/ dgongs 'dus kyi khrid chen bzhi/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid sogs shas che mdzad mod cing*/ gzhan rang rang so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs tha dad pa'i dbang*/ lung*/ khrid/ dmigs rim/ ngo sprod sogs gang la gang dgos gnang ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ mdor na/ snyigs dus mtha' khob kyi phyogs 'dir spyir nges don skor dang khyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i don rgyud kyi bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su mdzad pa'i bka' drin zla med du gyur pa lags// thun mong gdul bya'i rnam 'dren mang lags kyang*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag gtod nus pa dkon// de phyir mtshungs bral drin can 'di lta bu// tshe rabs kun tu yang dag brnyed gyur cig
/ces rje btsun dam pa 405) de nyid kyi zhabs rdul la spyi bos reg pa'i btsun pa padma legs grub kyis rgod tshang brag gi yang rjong du zin bris su bgyis pa dge'o// dge'o// 406)
